# Product comparison

## Summary table

| Product | Price | Project limit | Retention | Export |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---|
| Atlas | 120 USD | 40 projects | 7 days | CSV |
| Birch | 180 USD | 75 projects | 14 days | JSON |
| Cedar | 240 USD | 90 projects | 30 days | XML |

## Citations

- Atlas: `Price 120 USD; limit 40 projects; retention 7 days; export CSV.` [Source](http://127.0.0.1:53188/atlas)
- Birch: `Price 180 USD; limit 75 projects; retention 14 days; export JSON.` [Source](http://127.0.0.1:53188/birch)
- Cedar: `Price 240 USD; limit 90 projects; retention 30 days; export XML.` [Source](http://127.0.0.1:53188/cedar)

## Recommendation

**Best overall value: Birch.** It is the middle-priced option, but it offers a much higher project limit than Atlas and a better retention window, while costing less than Cedar. If you need the longest retention or highest project cap, Cedar is stronger; if budget is the primary concern, Atlas is cheapest.
